subject.title: feat(gateway): system change history RPC and Ask OpenClaw recent-changes panel

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this history reader as the public `operator.admin` gateway contract and Custodian product surface now, with its cursor and audit-entry schema treated as additive client API?
rationale: The feature introduces durable operator-visible behavior across gateway, native clients, persisted diagnostics, and the Custodian UI; the protected maintainer label and unavailable local source review prevent safely inferring final product and API acceptance.

options.title: Sponsor and complete compatibility review
options.body: Accept the direction in principle, then require source-level review and real end-to-end proof for the gateway contract, cursor semantics, redaction, and clients before merge.

options.title: Narrow to backend groundwork
options.body: Land only a separately reviewed generic audit-reader seam if maintainers want to defer the public RPC and Custodian UX contract.

options.title: Defer the product surface
options.body: Pause this PR until the broader system-agent overhaul direction has explicit maintainer acceptance.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and complete compatibility review
recommendation.body: Accept the direction in principle, then require source-level review and real end-to-end proof for the gateway contract, cursor semantics, redaction, and clients before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the directly related merged journal work and the proposed reader/UI integration, making them the closest available routing candidate in the supplied history.
